data.case_title: Rejection of school transport cost reimbursement (Schülerbeförderungskosten)
data.title: Landratsamt rejects reimbursement of son's school transport costs
data.summary: The Landratsamt Musterbreisgau (Amt für Schule und Bildung – Schülerbeförderung) rejected the application of 28 May 2025 to reimburse the monthly travel pass costs for the son's trip to the Musterberg-Gymnasium, because a closer school of the same type exists. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month after notification.
data.explanation: The district office (Landratsamt) has decided not to pay back the cost of your son's monthly travel pass to his current school, because a school of the same type is located closer to your home and the transport rules only cover travel to the nearest suitable school. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision; the app will show you the deadline by which it must arrive at the Landratsamt. If you miss it, the rejection becomes final and the reimbursement cannot be claimed for this school year. Consider seeking advice (e.g. from the school administration or a consumer/legal advice service) if you want to contest the decision.

key_facts.label: Application date (Antrag vom)
key_facts.quote:
mit diesem Bescheid vom 08.07.2025 lehnen wir Ihren Antrag vom 28.05.2025 ab, die
Kosten der Monatskarten Ihres Sohnes für den Weg zum Musterberg-Gymnasium zu
erstatten.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Landratsamt Musterbreisgau against the rejection, or file it to be recorded in person (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the rejection becomes final and the transport costs will not be reimbursed.
items.quote:

Musterbreisgau, Stadtstraße 2, 79104 Musterfreiburg, Widerspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur
Niederschrift.
